results.note: 8 sources x 3 arms x 2 seeds. Instrument evidence only: no Claim-2 verdict was emitted and none may be inferred from the point estimates.

known_defects_fixed.defect: panel digest hashed presentation order rather than the source set, so a cosmetic reordering would look like a different panel
a fabricated SHA-256 tail in this manifest: the envelope digest was recorded with a real 16-character prefix and an invented remainder
known_defects_fixed.detected_by: a spot check against the artifact; now permanently guarded by tests/test_claim2_handoff_manifest.py, which recomputes every digest from the file it describes
known_defects_fixed.severity_note: a wrong digest is worse than a missing one because it looks verified; handoff acceptance gates 2 and 3 depend on these values

known_defects_fixed.defect: a state whose enumeration raised was retried by every trajectory reaching it, each retry paying full enumeration cost while consuming no budget, and the truncation was labelled budget_exhausted rather than enumeration_failed
known_defects_fixed.detected_by: review of the rollout loop before launch
known_defects_fixed.impact_if_shipped: unbounded time on a pathological source, and enumeration failures silently inflating the early-dead-end rate of whichever arm walked into the bad state
known_defects_fixed.fix: failures are cached alongside successes and reported separately in every shard and in the analysis instrument checks

known_defects_fixed.defect: the rollout was launchable without --detach and a relaunch would have recomputed every already-completed source
known_defects_fixed.detected_by: main-lane operational report after a client-side DNS failure
known_defects_fixed.fix: resumable drive() with exact shard-identity matching; --detach in every documented command and in the launcher's own banner

measured_basis.this_lane_overhead_assumption: 1.2-1.5x for one extra model forward; the smoke measures it and records seconds_per_kernel_call per shard

what_it_resolves: whether the three arms produce genuinely different transition laws on real molecular supports
the true per-enumeration cost this lane pays, on which every later estimate depends

smoke_plan.resume_note: every task commits its shard to the volume as it completes and the driver skips sources whose committed shard matches source, horizon, seed set, kernel budget, panel_sha256 and family_law_sha256 and did not exhaust its budget; a relaunch after an outage costs only the sources that had not finished
smoke_plan.authorized_by: main lane, 2026-08-12, 8-source smoke only, no automatic promotion

recommended_next_action: Review these gates. The 36-source held-in development run is NOT authorized by this smoke passing; at the measured 16.43 s/enumeration it is roughly 10 container-hours. Weigh it against the provisional observation that R_theta moved less and cycled more than both unlearned arms on 8 sources.

operational_contract.reason: modal run uses a different interpreter without rdkit; molecule work belongs in a committed, mounted panel computed by a normal python3 script
durability_layers: server-side drive() fan-out so a client disconnect cannot stall .map()
modal run --detach so the app survives client death
per-source shard commit plus a resumable driver, because neither of the above survived a client-side DNS failure at launch in the main lane

health_measurements_behaving.note: revisit and reversal discriminate strongly across arms; dead-end rate is 0.000 for every arm

provisional_observation_not_a_result.warning: n=8 is below the pre-declared 20-source floor; no verdict was emitted and none may be inferred from these point estimates
provisional_observation_not_a_result.implication: R_theta moved less and cycled more than both unlearned arms on these 8 sources. If that holds at n=36 the frontier verdict is more likely incomparable than dominates, and the cycling rates are the direction the pathological-cycling stop rule watches. Operator collapse is NOT indicated: R_theta committed all 8 active families while uniform committed 6.
